metadata.description: A catalog of Claude skills for school studies: practice problem sets, worked solutions, SAT-style practice and more.

plugins.name: study-problem-sets
plugins.description: Builds lesson-focused problem set PDFs from your own concept guide, grades scanned handwritten answers against their answer key, solves screenshots of textbook pages with step-by-step solution PDFs, and builds SAT-style math practice sets scoped to any lesson range. Works with any numbered-lesson textbook or course.
